findings.message: Param filtro (filter:listaTarefas) has no state in the definition. Added the public state filtro (FiltroTarefas | null, persisted in localStorage) that takes part in the qryMinhasTarefas input; qryMinhasTarefas(filtro) publishes it and loads from the first page.

selectedTarefa (select:detalheTarefa) holds only the id and no member selects. Added selectDetalheTarefa(id | null), which publishes the id (kept in the URL), calls qryTarefa and keeps its output in tarefa; null clears both.

The definition has no <command>.input state for the commands the person fills in. Added drafts with setters: cmdCriarTarefaDraft (with the generated chaveCriacao and clearCmdCriarTarefaDraft; prefilled from params listaId and responsavelId), cmdSalvarEdicaoDraft and cmdSalvarChecklistDraft (prefilled from the open task), cmdDevolverDraft (reason).

cmdCriarTarefa returns a TarefaDetalhe, but a new row of tarefas (TarefaResumo) needs derived indicators (venceHoje, atrasada, quantidadeSubtarefas, progressoChecklist) that the output does not carry. The created task is shown in tarefa and selected, but not inserted into tarefas; the list shows it only on its next load.

Commands that return a task update the existing row of tarefas by id (or remove it when it leaves the current quick filter), but the derived indicators of the row (venceHoje, atrasada, quantidadeSubtarefas, progressoChecklist) keep their previous values because the detail output does not carry them (for example after a deadline edit or a checklist save).
The paged list has no page param/state; the page and hasMore live inside tarefas. qryMinhasTarefas(filtro, page, append) takes the page to load; a pager replaces, a load-more appends.
